questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 301, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)' in the 21/22 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Annerie Dercksen holds it, with a total of 62.

questions.question: At Kingsmead stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
Who holds the record for 'Most Matches as Captain' (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 119.

questions.question: How many sixes separate the all-time #1 (Sunette Loubser) and #2 (Kirstie Thomson) six-hitters (List A) in the 11/12 season?
questions.explanation: Sunette Loubser: 9 — Kirstie Thomson: 8 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: Who scored South Africa Women's first-ever ODI century, 101 not out against Ireland in December 2000?
questions.explanation: Olivier's century came during South Africa's early years back in international cricket after readmission in 1997.
